normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to exists only to supply the destination argument of the transfer function and should be merged into it.
Parameter _value exists only to supply the amount argument of the transfer function and should be merged into it.
Parameter _from exists only to supply the source address of the internal _transfer routine and should be merged into it.
Parameter _spender exists only to supply the spender argument of approve and should be merged into it.
Parameter amount exists only to supply the mint amount and should be merged into the mint function.
Parameter _reason exists only to supply the lock reason argument and should be merged into the lock function.
Parameter _amount exists only to supply the lock amount argument and should be merged into the lock function.
Parameter _time exists only to supply the lock duration argument and should be merged into the lock function.
The local unlockableTokens accumulator is consumed by the this.transfer(...) external call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Local validUntil is computed from now and _time and stored only inside lock, so it merges into the lock function.
